claims.text: Many reviewers say the cream effectively moisturizes and heals dry, rough, itchy, or scaly skin.
Several reviewers report it helps with eczema, sometimes reducing the need for steroid creams.
Reviewers frequently praise the texture, noting it absorbs quickly and is not greasy or oily.
Some reviewers say it helped with skin infections or breakouts such as folliculitis, zits, or rashes, though one notes it was not strong enough alone.
A few reviewers mention it helped with scars or other specific skin concerns like surgical scars and hand/nail irritation.
